description: Try a miniature STS3215 geared tweezer gripper, no wider than the servo in its narrowest orientation (24.8 mm from repository CAD); preserve existing versions, publish a new parametric design and verify the complete moving envelope.

results.identified_issue: The requested narrow dimension is the STS3215 CAD case width, 24.8 mm. Retained the concurrently drafted plural v317_generalist_micro_tweezers design after coordinating ownership with Jarvis; the singular exploratory variant was archived outside the repo and never published or committed. Base 16 builds on Base 15; Gripper 23 builds on Gripper 22. Integrated miniature jaws intentionally cannot take the full-size strap handles, so viewer_parts no_handles is published and gallery mix hides that interface while flagging older Grippers. Corrected horn-hole phase to 45 degrees using the imported CAD cross-section (holes at ±4.95 mm), added countersunk bolt seats and 2.2 mm center-head relief. Hardware heads and cable clearance are envelope references; no physical screw-engagement or strength claim. Exact continuous X extrema for all STL vertices prove the commanded 0–9 degree width; 19 half-degree collision poses cover jaw/jaw, moving/frame, moving/hardware. The 40 degree over-opening regression must fail. All 10 positioned reference/component meshes and five print-oriented meshes pass manifold/positive volume checks. 32 selected publisher/gallery/hinge/miniature tests pass; the full catalog pose test separately has a pre-existing missing v306 direct-drive pose, outside this item. Tune rendering verified with jaw_len=40 and rejects swept width violations. Published catalog reports Base 16 ready, ten models, Gripper 23, Base 15 lineage, no_handles true. Servo is a dimensioned envelope, not detailed imported mesh; tolerances, loads, travel-limit calibration and hardware fit need real tests. No mechanical stops: unrestricted servo rotation is not within the verified envelope.
results.summary: Added a servo-width miniature geared tweezer prototype.
results.detailed_description:
Added Base 16 with Gripper 23: five printed parts, equal counter-rotating gears, 42 mm jaws and about 13 mm opening. Existing versions are preserved, with dimensions adjustable in Tune.

The complete 0–9° commanded stroke fits within 24.8 mm, including modeled screw heads and cable clearance. Review Base 16 with Gripper 23 in the preview. This is a resin or machined prototype; it needs software travel limits and physical fit and strength checks.

visual.alt: Miniature geared tweezers fit the 24.8 mm servo width throughout the commanded stroke.
